in_marathi.name: Hrithik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrithik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hrithik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hrithik', which means 'intelligent' and 'radiant'. This name is often given to babies born under the influence of the Sun or Lord Vishnu. It is believed that children with this name possess great wisdom, intelligence, and courage.
